name: Segment Tracts with ROIs
summary: Segments tracts from a white matter classification by including or excluding streamlines that reach selected ROIs, using MRtrix3 tckedit, and outputs the new tractogram and classification.
description: Splits each tract of the input classification into its own .tck, then for each line of roiNames filters it with tckedit -include or -exclude for the listed ROIs (endpoints only or anywhere along the streamline, optionally inverted). Empty results are dropped and the remaining tracts are merged into a new tractogram and classification. ROIs must be in the same space as the tractogram.

inputs.description: The path to the track/tck datatype
The path to the classification.mat structure from the wmc datatype
The path to the rois datatype
inputs.requirements: Must be in the same space as the tractogram.

inputs.description: DWI image used only as the reference anatomy for loading and saving streamlines.

outputs.description: The classification structure including a classification.mat structure that contains the streamline indices in the whole-brain tractogram.
Intermediate per-tract .tck files and track name lists.

parameters.description:
names of the rois to intersect. multiple rois can be used at one time to generate a single track, and multiple tracks can be generated at one time. groupings of rois go on a single line, multiple tracks goes on multiple lines. roi names come directly from input roi datatype, and text should match the text inbetween the .nii.gz and ROI extensions and prefixes.

example:
freesurfer-11121 freesurfer-11161
freesurfer-parietal_L freesurfer-11121
freesurfer_occipital_R

two types:
1) "include": include streamlines that have endpoints in rois
2) "exclude": include all other streamlines except those that end in rois

one type per track. for example, for three tracks:

include
exclude
include
If you want the inverse of the operation (i.e. all streamlines that don't end in a roi), set this to true. default = false
If you want to only segment based on endpoints, set this to true. else, set to false. default = true

citations.text: Tournier J-D, Smith RE, Raffelt D, et al. MRtrix3: A fast, flexible and open software framework for medical image processing and visualisation. NeuroImage 202:116137 (2019).

failure_modes.message: something went wrong. check derivatives and logs
failure_modes.cause: No streamlines survived the ROI filtering, so no merged tractogram was written.
failure_modes.fix: Check ROI names, intersect_type and endpoints_only; make sure ROIs overlap the tracts.
